title: Options when your ball is in a yellow penalty area
question: Your ball is inside a yellow penalty area. What are your options according to the rules?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies in the penalty area.
Drop a ball back on the line outside the penalty area with a one-stroke penalty.
Pick up your ball and place it anywhere you like on the course without penalty.
Go back and play a shot again from your previous position with a one-stroke penalty.

explanation: You can play the ball as it lies, or take relief options for a one-stroke penalty: either drop back on the line behind the hazard or return to your previous shot position and replay.

juniorVersion.title: What can you do if your ball lands in a yellow penalty area?
juniorVersion.question: Your ball is in a yellow penalty area, like a pond or stream marked with yellow stakes or lines. What are you allowed to do?

choices.text: You can try to hit the ball just as it is in the penalty area.
You can drop a new ball further back in line with the hole, but not in the penalty area, and count one extra shot.
You can pick up your ball and put it anywhere you want on the course with no penalty.
You can go back to where you hit your last shot, play again from there, and count one extra shot.

juniorVersion.explanation: If your ball lands in a yellow penalty area, like a pond, you have three choices: You can play the ball from where it is, if you can. Or, you can drop a new ball further back in line with the hole and add one shot. Or, you can go back to where you last hit from, play again, and add one shot.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place on the course like a pond or stream marked with yellow or red lines or stakes, where special rules apply.
Letting the ball fall from your knee to put it back in play.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show children a pond or area with yellow stakes, and walk through each choice. Let them practise dropping a ball backwards in line with the flag.
likelyMisconceptions: You can pick up your ball and put it anywhere you want without a penalty.
You only have to take a penalty if you choose to play outside the penalty area.
